title: Songs and Tears Together
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They laid the first big heavy stone
Of God's house on the ground.
The trumpets played, the cymbals crashed,
And joy was all around.

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father loves your heart,
Your feelings, big and small.
Your tears and songs can come at once,
He holds them, one and all.

[Verse 2]
The oldest ones remembered well
The temple they once knew.
So happy tears rolled down their cheeks,
And God saw each tear, too.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, and what you feel
Is safe with God tonight.
He saw the songs, He saw the tears,
He holds your whole heart tight.

[Chorus]
mood: Chapel music. A slow, swaying three-beat lilt rocks beneath the voice, part celebration and part tender tears, the way the people sang and cried at once over the first big stone. The chorus opens wide and warm, holding both feelings together. By the final verse the sway grows slower and lower, the brightness melts into a hush, and the song settles like a hand resting on a child's chest.
